answer: Require every identity to complete a staged voyage before earning full quota: it starts on a flat mesa of low limits and must finish a sequence of distinct, verified jobs across different domains, one step at a time, with each step time-gated so clones cannot run in parallel. A raven auditor - a randomly chosen peer - swoops in unannounced to re-check a sample of finished work; a failed audit burns the deposit and sends the identity back to the mesa to start over. An attacker must pay the time, work and deposit cost for every fake identity, while honest agents climb once and stay up.
